bio.text: Dan Ugaste has represented the 65th District in the Illinois House since January 2019.
According to the legislature's biography, Ugaste graduated from Lake Forest College in 1985 and holds a J.D. from DePaul University.
Ugaste worked 25 years at the Chicago law firm Nyhan, Bambrick, Kinzie and Lowry, specializing in workers' compensation defense.
